website.homeSubtitle: Your comprehensive e-commerce platform for discovering and selling products.
website.aboutText: AskTea.ai is a modern e-commerce platform that connects sellers with shoppers. Powered by AI, it helps you discover the right products, generate compelling descriptions, and manage your store with ease.
website.aboutMissionText: To make online shopping and selling simple, fast, and accessible for everyone.

searchEval.title: Search Evaluation
searchEval.description: Generate catalog-realistic queries, run deterministic parse-path searches, judge relevance, and track MRR@10 / Recall@10 baselines.
searchEval.metricsDescription: MRR@10 and Recall@10 over evaluated queries (queries with at least one relevant judgment).
searchEval.noMetrics: No evaluated queries yet — import the golden set or judge LLM-generated queries.
searchEval.generateDescription: Ask the AI Engine to propose realistic user queries from the live catalog (product types, search-affecting attributes, major option values).
searchEval.importDescription: Import reviewed queries as JSON: ['{'"text": "…", "locale": "en|ar", "relevant_ids": ["…"]'}']. Source is set to seed and judgments to relevant.
searchEval.invalidJson: Invalid JSON — expected an array of '{' text, locale, relevant_ids '}' objects.
searchEval.judgeDescription: Run the search, then mark which results are relevant. Relevant items are stored as judgments; the query becomes evaluated.
searchEval.noResults: No results returned by the engine.
searchEval.name: Name
